div.div:
Recovery is target-specific
Some remote-response partials conservatively set needsSync: true even for board-only operations. Inspect the target first.
Sync repairs issue cache, not missing native edges, board values, or requested types. GitHub calls have no automatic retry.
If create_sub_issue created a child but attachment failed, reuse that child with add_sub_issue—never recreate it blindly.
